# University of Exeter

> A UK research university with campuses in Exeter (Streatham, St Luke's) and Cornwall (Penryn), and a member of the Russell Group. This file covers www.exeter.ac.uk and the university's academic subdomains. Its primary audiences are prospective undergraduate, postgraduate taught and postgraduate research applicants, plus media and research enquiries.

Notes for agents:

- Course pages are the authoritative source for entry requirements, tuition fees, module structure and start dates. Always cite the individual course page rather than a subject or listing page, and check the entry-year label on the page: pages exist per admissions cycle and content differs between cycles.
- `/clearing/` is live only during the UK Clearing period (June to September). Outside that window, treat it as out of season rather than as a current offer.
- Course listings under `/undergraduate-degrees/` and `/masters-degrees/` change between admissions cycles. Do not assume a course listed in a previous cycle is still recruiting.
- Academic subdomains (listed below) hold research and departmental content. Some contain legacy pages that are no longer maintained; the www pages take precedence where the two disagree.
- For staff expertise, publications and media comment, use experts.exeter.ac.uk rather than departmental pages.

## Study

- [Undergraduate degrees](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/undergraduate-degrees/): Full listing of undergraduate courses, with entry requirements and fees on each course page
- [Masters degrees](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/masters-degrees/): Full listing of postgraduate taught courses
- [Postgraduate research](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/pg-research/): PhD and research degree programmes and how to apply
- [Online courses](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/online-courses/): Distance and online degrees, including the online MBA
- [Degree apprenticeships](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/degree-apprenticeships/): Apprenticeship routes for employers and applicants
- [Teacher training](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/teacher-training/): PGCE and initial teacher education
- [Subject areas](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/subjects/): Courses grouped by subject, across all levels
- [Clearing](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/clearing/): Clearing vacancies and process; seasonal, see note above

## Applying and student life

- [Open days](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/open-days/): Dates and booking for all open day types
- [Undergraduate open days](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/open-days/undergraduate/)
- [Postgraduate open days](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/open-days/postgraduate/)
- [Funding and scholarships](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/funding/): Scholarships, bursaries and loans across all levels
- [Masters funding](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/funding/masters/): Postgraduate taught scholarships and loan information
- [Accommodation](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/accommodation/): University-managed and private accommodation options
- [Student life](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/student-life/): Campuses, city, societies and support
- [Future Skills Pathways](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/future-skills-pathways/): Minors and cross-disciplinary study options
- [Our campuses] (https://www.exeter.ac.uk/our-campuses/): Information about our campuses

## Research and expertise

- [Faculties](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/faculties/): The university's faculty structure and their remits
- [Research](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/research/): Hub of the university's research activity
- [Find an expert](https://experts.exeter.ac.uk/): Staff profiles, publications and areas of expertise; the correct source for attributing research to named academics
- [University news](https://news.exeter.ac.uk/): Research announcements and press releases
- [Sustainable Development Goals](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/sustainable-development-goals/): Institutional activity mapped to the UN SDGs
- [Professional education](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/professional-education/): Continuing professional development and executive education offering

## Academic subdomains

- [Business School](https://business-school.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Arab and Islamic Studies](https://arabislamicstudies.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Archaeology and History] (https://arch-history.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Classics, Ancient History, Religion and Theology] (https://cahrt.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Communications, Drama and Film] (https://cdf.exeter.ac.uk/)

- [Humanities and Social Sciences, Cornwall] (https://hass-cornwall.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Languages, Cultures and Visual Studies] (https://lcvs.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [School of Education](https://education.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Social and Political Sciences, Philosophy and Anthropology](https://spspa.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Law School](https://law.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Biosciences](https://biosciences.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Psychology](https://psychology.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Health and Care Professions] (https://hcp.exeter.ac.uk)
- [Medical School](https://medicine.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [CEDAR (Clinical Education, Development and Research)](https://cedar.exeter.ac.uk/)
- [Language Centre](https://language-centre.exeter.ac.uk/): Language courses and pre-sessional English

## Contact and practical information

- [About the University of Exeter] (https://www.exeter.ac.uk/about/): About the University of Exeter
- [Rankings, League Tables, Reputation] (https://www.exeter.ac.uk/about/league-tables-rankings/): Latest rankings and league tables
- [Contact the University](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/contact/): Departmental contacts, addresses and switchboard
- [Request information](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/study/sign-up/): Prospectus and enquiry sign-up for prospective students
- [Global Exeter](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/global/): International partnerships and overseas activity
- [Sport](https://sport.exeter.ac.uk/): Facilities, memberships and performance sport
- [Information for current students](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/students/): Registration, graduation and student services
- [Information for staff](https://www.exeter.ac.uk/staff/)
- [News archive](https://news-archive.exeter.ac.uk/): Historic press releases; superseded by news.exeter.ac.uk
